title: Prove nine-call bound for parity-uniform mixed targets
body:
## Summary

```diff
 Three invertible 3-by-3 targets, arbitrary restored dirty scalar roles:
- identical targets require at least nine rank-one calls
+ equal target classes in the actual generated lattice H/2H require nine
```

Adds `research/bit-parity-uniform-targets/`. This is a written scoped lower bound, not supplier admission or a new kappa. The common class may be zero. A nine-call example with targets `I`, `I+4E21`, `I+4E12` is different, noncommuting and has no common full rational flag, so the extension is strict.

The new steps are projection-stable generated-lattice parity, a parity-uniform 2-by-2 lemma for the span-four case, and spectral-coefficient handling when the scalar split changes the active basis. Unequal target classes remain open.

Task `bit-new-register-model`, priority revision 5, scope changed from construction to this specific PR2900 handoff. Scientific base `4e8ceb80ecbc11049a44856b91f74a7448a75e93`; canonical refresh `2845e0957e938df723ece5f0164838b15501e0ae` leaves guidance and all four proof inputs unchanged. Exact Git blobs and SHA256 pins are in `SOURCES.json`; commands, overlap coverage and remaining obligations are in `TASK.json`.

[Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2898#discussioncomment-18973163).

Credit: Tuafo's identical-target reduction; David Govea's unflagged three-role theorem; waynenilsen and woklerx's dirty-workspace and one-relation results; Ali Romman's PR468 and its eumemic/PR288 and huxint/PR203 lineage; the retained mixed-target compression result. Predecessor files stay unchanged.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR2900 bounded mixed-target dirty workspace but left this equal-class subcase unresolved.
- **After:** the written proof excludes eight calls in that subcase, with a sharp nonidentical nine-call example.
- Five exact lattice/formal-word fixtures; 3,969 independent integer-combination cases; 53,760 mixed spectral split cases, including 27,936 compatible nondiagonal endpoints.
- Seven behavioral test groups pass, including relocated normal/optimized CLI, three actual implementation mutants and receipt corruption.
- Registered Python 3.12.15 replay, optimized Python 3.13.5 replay, all 144 workflow tests on Python 3.12 without skips, Ruff, warning-as-error compilation and committed-byte preflight pass locally. The retained PR720 quick check also passes. Hosted CI is separate.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-parity-uniform-targets
python3 -I -O -B research/bit-parity-uniform-targets/verify.py
python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
```

The universal claim is the written proof using named predecessor theorems, not an inference from these finite cases. The full predecessor computer-assisted search was not rerun. Independent human/formal review, native realization, hosting, precision/tape and a complete supplier remain outside scope.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast radius:** research-only.

One new opt-in package. No selected frontier, supplier, frozen input, root verifier or existing replay is changed.
